svg.title: IconTypeVariant
svg.desc: help.html "The five words": the remaining two type marks, which only the quick-reference sheet shows (the Explorer tree stops at Ingredient). Same treatment as the three above - the mockup builds both entirely from <rect>/<circle>, so the rounded rects are written out as paths here and the fill-only accent details are dropped. Variant (help.html:295): a picture frame (<rect x=4 y=5 w=16 h=14 rx=1.7>) with a horizon stroke. Lost: the accent-filled sun (<circle cx=8.8 cy=9.3 r=1.7>) - decoration inside the frame, not the silhouette. Set (help.html:299): a 2x2 grid of <rect w=7.4 h=7.4 rx=1.5>. The mockup strokes three and fills the fourth with the accent instead of stroking it; here all four are stroked, since a single-stroke path cannot carry the fill and OMITTING the square would break the 2x2 grid that identifies the glyph.
